The document states that ordinary questions are required, but row-specific requirements for open-ended lists are not fully explicit; q105_1 is treated as required because the document explicitly says to type none in the first box, while q105_2–q105_10 are treated as optional.

Q130 is represented from the SAV dictionary because the document specifies a matrix whose individual response fields are present only as dictionary variables. The exact displayed columns depend on Q110 awareness routing.
The provided document contains an appendix privacy notice but no response variables; it is retained as non-questionnaire reference text and does not generate groups.
Administrative variables listed in administrative_variables_handled_by_application are not duplicated as questionnaire groups or blocks.
Shared test-case checking should apply to all open-text variables using tokens: test, TEST, Test, TEst, TESt, tEST, ?, .
